name: Empire Game
detailed_description:
Diverse strategies and resource management
In the game, players need to flexibly allocate resources according to the situation to maximize their benefits. Resource management and consumption strategies in the early, middle and late stages determine the success or failure of players. Make rational use of races and arms to develop the best development route and give full play to the value of each resource.

Race and Arms Matching
The game has nearly 10 unique races, each equipped with 8 arms and a rich neutral arm. Players can formulate the strongest tactics and build a powerful battle lineup based on the characteristics of the race and the combination of arms.

Hero training and skill application
The hero system is very deep, and players can choose different heroes and improve their talents and skills. Careful hero training and equipment matching can play a huge role in battle and help players win.

Expansion, defense and diplomacy
The game map is random, and players need to weigh expansion, defense and diplomacy strategies according to terrain and environmental changes. Reasonable decisions can help players gain the upper hand in complex situations and achieve victory.

Hundred-player Joyful Battle
A perfect combination of exciting battles and a joyful atmosphere! The game supports up to five or six hundred combat units on the same screen, creating a shocking and grand battlefield. The exaggerated and funny action design of the characters injects a relaxed and humorous fun into the fierce battle. The scene is lively and the rhythm is refreshing, allowing you to enjoy the thrill of fierce battles in laughter!

short_description: Strategic game inspired by "Heroes of Might and Magic" & "Hero's Hour" with auto-battler combat. Multiple races embody real-world civilizations (China, France, etc.). Randomly generated maps ensure unique playthroughs. Adapt, expand, and conquer in a dynamic world!
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, German, Indonesian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Vietnamese, Korean, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Polish, Dutch

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GT440（512M）or AMD Radeon equivalent or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
